title: Matched
description: Matched is made for competitive play & performance
body:
## Matched is made for competitive play & performance
Matched is to be the best Modpack for competitive servers and beats other clients performance such as **Feather** and **Lunar** while being lightweight and you know.... free of the ads!

## Server Support

- **_Matched_** does work mostly every competitive server with no issues, **Why** "mostly"? I obviously cannot playtest each server so if you do have any issues please make a new issue report in the Github Issue Tracker don't hesitate and make one so I can help :)  
  - (**PLEASE** make sure you didn't add any mods that would obviously be considered cheating on servers before making an issue report)
  
## Main Performance Mod and Quality Of Life mods!

### Sodium
- **_Matched's_** main performance mod is **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)** (By **[CaffeineMC](https://modrinth.com/organization/caffeinemc)**) 
###   Quality Of Life mods
  - **_Matched_** also uses **Quality Of Life** mods such as **[Shield Fixes](https://modrinth.com/mod/complete-shield-fixes), [Shield Status](https://modrinth.com/mod/shield-statuses), [Crosshair Addons Public](https://modrinth.com/mod/crosshair-addons-public)** (All by **[Walksy](https://modrinth.com/user/Walksy)**), **[Gnetum](https://modrinth.com/mod/gnetum)**, **[Ixeris](https://modrinth.com/mod/ixeris)** (By **[Decce6](https://modrinth.com/user/decce6)**), [**uku's Armor HUD**](https://modrinth.com/mod/ukus-armor-hud), (By **[uku](https://modrinth.com/user/uku)**), **[AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin)** (By **[squeek502](https://modrinth.com/user/squeek502)**) and **much** more!

**[BetterShields](https://modrinth.com/mod/bettershields)** is only in version 1.0.0 and won't be added unless REALLY wanted due to it having mostly the samefunctionally to **[Shield Fixes](https://modrinth.com/mod/complete-shield-fixes)** still great a mod though and you can add it on your own if you really want it
